# ShipIt Unity Supabase Toolkit

> The most complete Supabase integration for Unity: 38 RLS-hardened backend
> packs, full C# source, editor tooling, a multi-provider AI assistant and an
> operator web console. Built by ShipIt.

Works with any Supabase project (hosted or self-hosted). Requires Unity
2022.3 LTS or newer. Distributed with full C# source — no DLLs, no NuGet.

## Main pages

- [Overview](https://shipit-unity.github.io/index.html): product position, pack cloud, workflow, hardening notes.
- [Documentation](https://shipit-unity.github.io/documentation.html): setup, auth/database/realtime/storage/edge-function examples, all 38 backend packs, game services table, AI & MCP server, security model, troubleshooting.
- [Release notes](https://shipit-unity.github.io/updates.html): per-version changelog highlights; the package also ships a full CHANGELOG.md.
- [Live-Ops console](https://shipit-unity.github.io/live-ops.html): self-hostable operator dashboard — overview KPIs, analytics with CSV export, pgmq queues, pg_cron jobs, announcements, feature flags, remote config, rewards/mail, moderation, leaderboard, players.
- [Privacy](https://shipit-unity.github.io/privacy.html): no analytics, no cookies, no telemetry.

## Core API surface (C#)

- Initialize: `SupabaseClient.InitializeFromResources();`
- Auth: email/password, magic link, phone OTP, anonymous, OAuth PKCE deep links,
  Apple/Google ID tokens, MFA (TOTP), CAPTCHA, identity linking, GDPR export/delete.
- Database: typed query builder (`From<T>()` with lambda filters), full-text
  search, auto-pagination (`GetAllAsync`), offline cache + mutation replay.
- Realtime: postgres changes, broadcast, presence, private RLS-gated channels,
  native browser WebSocket on WebGL.
- Storage: uploads, resumable TUS with offset recovery, image transforms,
  signed URLs, Texture2D/Sprite/AudioClip loaders, bucket management.
- Edge Functions: typed invoke plus token streaming (`InvokeStreamingAsync`,
  SSE or raw chunks, main-thread callbacks).
- Feature services: QueueService (pgmq), CronService (pg_cron),
  HybridSearchService (RRF fusion), AnalyticsService, CloudSaveService,
  FeatureFlagService, RemoteConfigService, EconomyService, LeaderboardService,
  SecureLeaderboardService, MatchmakingService, TournamentService,
  RankedMatchmakingService, ModerationService, MailboxService, QuestService,
  BattlePassService, SeasonService, WebhookService, ReferralService,
  IdempotencyService, AuditService, RateLimitService, PushTokenService,
  IapValidationService, FriendService, GuildService, InventoryService,
  AchievementService, DailyRewardService, CloudSaveHistoryService,
  SemanticSearchService, RagService, AiChatClient, AiEmbeddingClient.

## Security model

Ship only the anon/publishable key in clients. Service-role keys stay in
machine-local editor preferences and are never written to runtime assets or
builds. Privileged mutations (economy grants, quest progress, battle-pass XP)
are service-role-only Postgres functions. Every bundled pack enables RLS with
explicit policies and function execute allowlists.
